summary: refactor(oauth): move ScopeSet and constants to @fxa/accounts/oauth
description:
Because:

- fxa-shared is moving to Nx libs, and ScopeSet and the OAuth constants belong in @fxa/accounts/oauth.

This commit:

- Moves scopes.ts and constants.ts to libs/accounts/oauth with a ScopeSet brand that coerce() checks.
- Ports the scopes mocha spec to Jest, with a two-copy case.
- Leaves fxa-shared re-export shims, including both default exports.
- Points all fxa-auth-server importers at @fxa/accounts/oauth.
- Adds the @fxa/accounts/oauth alias to the fxa-admin-server build tsconfig.

Closes FXA-10667
